TCK-003 reported drift on DSN-015: the design gives Item.isOpen the parameter name "now", but the code in src/auction-api/Item.ts used "at". The ticket was handled in the code direction (P4), so the code was changed to match the design and the design was left as it is.

In P4 the parameter of isOpen in src/auction-api/Item.ts was renamed from "at" to "now" in the signature and in the method body. This is only a rename: the method still returns true when the auction status is open and the given time is before the end time. No requirement, use case or design element changed. After the edit, the agent reported that drift detection found no differences and that the typecheck passed.

The agent could not run tests during the P4 run. The test result recorded afterwards (2026-11-27 13:29) shows 57 passed and 0 failed. That covers the tests the agent flagged as still to run, so nothing is open for this ticket.
